window: signature + next 60 lines per kernel (epic_u2o/corpus_miner.py: signature line, then lines[i:min(len, i+60)])
unit: idiom_hits[idiom] = number of kernels whose 60-line WINDOW contains the idiom -- NOT corpus coverage. A zero (atomicAdd 0, wmma:: 0, __shfl 0) is a statement about prefixes, not about real code: whole-file counts in metrics.json find wmma in 38 files of the same tree. Read alongside whole-file coverage, never alone.
